title: Add multi-value autocomplete chips and accessible form-level error summaries
creator: Lina Reyes
description:
Problem: Several product teams have requested a consistent pattern for multi-value text inputs (email lists, tag selectors) and an accessible way to surface form-level validation when multiple fields are invalid. Current component library has ad-hoc implementations: comma-separated inputs, freeform text areas, or product-specific chips. That leads to inconsistent keyboard behavior, screen reader announcements, and token spacing visual regressions when density tokens change.

Goal: Design a canonical multi-value input (autocomplete + chips) that uses existing tokens, supports prefix/KV caching visual hints in Redwood Console, works with browser autofill, and exposes a single, screen-reader-friendly form-level error summary for bulk validation errors. Provide specs and handoff artifacts for engineering to implement a11y-first markup and token mapping.

Scope: Component spec for MultiValueTextField (label, placeholder, chip list, freeform entry), updated token mappings for chip padding & border-radius in compact/regular densities, keyboard and screen reader interaction patterns, and form-level error summary component that can be anchored to any form and lists field-level messages with links to focus targets.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec includes markup and aria recommendations (aria-live, aria-describedby, role=listbox) with concrete examples for email list and tag selector use cases
Keyboard: Enter/Comma/Tab create chips; Arrow keys navigate chips; Backspace removes previous chip when input empty; Escape clears typed value
Screen reader: adding/removing chips triggers an assertive announcement; error summary role=alert lists errors and focuses the first invalid field when a link is activated
Tokens: chip padding, gap, and font-size map to compact and regular density token sets; provide token name mappings and fallback values
Works correctly with browser autofill (pre-populated tokens) and preserves unique ID handling for focus management
Engineering PR includes visual regression tests against the provided snapshot and accessibility tests (axe or equivalent)
Design review approved by PM and one engineering reviewer; edge cases documented (max-chips, long chip truncation)
decisions: Prefer chip list UI over inline comma-delimited text for discoverability and improved hit targets on touch devices
Use role=listbox + option pattern for suggestion dropdown to keep consistency with existing Select component and to leverage screen reader familiarity
Implement error summary as a separate FormErrorSummary component that accepts an ordered list of {fieldKey, message} and renders role=alert with links to scrollTo and focus targets

Trade-off: the chosen approach increases DOM nodes for many chips. We will mitigate by recommending virtualization for very large token lists and adding a max-chips prop with 'more' summary when exceeded
tasks: Design: final artwork + spec for states (default, focus, typing, invalid, disabled) - Lina
Engineering: implement base component, aria attributes, keyboard handling - Noah
Tokens: add chip-size and chip-gap entries for compact/regular densities and update token mapping docs - Design System token owner
QA: create test matrix for keyboard, screen reader, and autofill scenarios
Accessibility review: run axe + manual SR tests on VoiceOver and NVDA
Docs: write usage guide, migration notes, and example recipe for email list validation

2026-03-08 - Marco Liu (Eng): Reviewed keyboard flow. Suggested that comma + enter both create chips, but Enter should prefer suggestion selection when list is open. Need to clarify in spec.

2026-03-09 - Priya Sharma (PM): High customer impact flagged by Support - several customers reported confusion when multiple validation errors appear. Please include form-level summary with anchor links.

2026-03-11 - Accessibility Review (draft) - Omar El-Amin: Proposed aria-live="assertive" for add/remove announcements and role=alert for the global error summary. Call out announced content length limits for VoiceOver.

2026-03-12 - Noah Patel: Engineering spike started. Implemented keyboard nav prototype and pushed to branch feature/multi-value-input. Found DOM bloat when creating 500+ chips; proposing 'collapse' view showing first 10 + '+N' summary. Needs design decision for collapsed state.

2026-03-14 - Lina Reyes: Updated tokens to include chip-compact-gap and chip-regular-gap. Added acceptance criteria for visual regression tests and autofill handling. Scheduled design review 2026-03-16.
